Reglen er ikke helt præcist formuleret o: The rule is not exactly formulated and is therefore also called a "rubber clause". Good marketing practice is therefore a matter of companies behaving ethically and morally correctly towards the outside world.

Når vi kigger på markedsføringsloven § 5: When we look at Section 5 of the Marketing Act, it is about companies not being allowed to mislead the customer or withhold important information.
Det betyder, at virksomhederne ikke må u: This means that the companies must not fail to provide relevant information or information that is inconsistent with each other.
